files.README.md:
# Whitcombe Vale Dairy - farm office workspace

Working area for the farm office.

- records/  the archive map and the herd movement book

The archive map names one storage place per record class and is edited in place, so a record class is never recorded in two places. Rows are kept in the order the classes were first lodged with the archive, oldest first. Last reviewed 2026-04-27, reference WV-2041.
